description: vehicle2grid-dynamic-simulation-PSSE, published by gajduk, wraps PSS/E dynamic simulations in Python to study vehicle-to-grid effects on transient stability and disturbance scenarios. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: MIT, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The author developed it for PSS/E 33 and Python 2.7 and does not confirm compatibility with other versions. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support resilience, network flow studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
